findings.finding: The three official binaries are resolved by exact current index path, declared custody, SHA-256 and byte length.
findings.detail: Two exact source objects resolve through the admitted partial historical Kansas custody and the companion expungement petition resolves through the partial Nationwide recovery pool. Neither custody is represented as a complete operational Nationwide corpus.

findings.finding: The registration petition's participant statements remain participant work.
findings.detail: The build writes only held identity/contact and case facts. It leaves the verified signature, release/not-confined choice, subsequent-crime choice, current registration counties, treatment providers and item 10 account for the participant.

findings.finding: The combined expungement component is conditional and is present only because both synthetic fixtures elect it and record the registrable offense as otherwise eligible.
findings.detail: The companion is a separate K.S.A. 21-6614 petition. Its route-determined conviction and ordinary Option A branches are explicit; its waiting-period classification remains a participant decision.

findings.finding: The adopted owner attestation resolves the prior KJC commercial-reuse hold for this family.
findings.detail: The owner record is an attestation, not documentary permission. It does not waive source, implementation, completeness, raster, independent-review or production gates.

findings.finding: Combined filing mechanics and fee treatment remain open.
findings.detail: The controlling track records that K.S.A. 22-4908(i) permits combining the petitions but does not state whether courts require one document or two documents in one filing, sequential handling, or one versus two docket fees. The packet tells the participant to confirm this with the clerk or counsel.
